## Approach

For this assignment, we need to have a data downloaded for dataset that is continous time series for two or more items. We need to Use window functions (in SQL or dplyr) to calculate the year-to-date average and the six-day moving averages for each item.

I find getSymbols function to be more helpful in downloading the stocks data (Suggested by Chatgpt) but I was also able to download a csv for both Apple and Microsoft from Nasdaq.

Once I've read the data into a dataframe, I'd examine the columns that're being read in. I'd clean up the data so it's useful. I'd organize the data by item. I would calculate the yearly average

then I'd use window functions (OVER in SQL, cummean and slide_dbl() functions to calculate corresponding averages.

## Reading in the stocks data: 

I'd be using the following data.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(quantmod)
##downloading the stocks data. 
AAPL <- getSymbols("AAPL", 
                   src = "yahoo",
                   from = "2025-01-01",
                   auto.assign = FALSE)
AAPL
AAPLCSV <- read.csv("HistoricalData_1789699125674.csv")
AAPLCSV
```
